'''Kytoma''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], she sent an Imperial spacer to infiltrate a group of resistance terrorists who were operating out of the abandoned bunkers in the cliffs above Ghost Town.
